-- Fix status for companies that were enriched (have city) but marked as failed
UPDATE companies
SET enrichment_status = 'enriched'
WHERE search_id = 750001
  AND enrichment_status = 'failed'
  AND city IS NOT NULL
  AND city != '';

-- Reset companies with no city back to pending so they can be retried
UPDATE companies
SET enrichment_status = 'pending'
WHERE search_id = 750001
  AND enrichment_status = 'failed'
  AND (city IS NULL OR city = '');

-- Show the resulting breakdown
SELECT enrichment_status, COUNT(*) as count
FROM companies
WHERE search_id = 750001
GROUP BY enrichment_status;
